scripts.text:
[Refine Master]
Hello!
What's up?
I'm a specialist
for refining items,
but I don't work anymore.
scripts.translation:
[精煉大師]
你好，有事嗎？我是裝備精煉專家，不過已經不幹了。

scripts.text: I'll go on my way.
scripts.translation: 我先走了

scripts.text: Hmm... this makes me curious.
scripts.translation: 嗯...這讓我很好奇

scripts.text:
[Refine Master]
Take care, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[精煉大師]
保重，冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Refine Master]
Actually, I sometimes provide refine services for adventurers with a ^006400Refine Ticket^000000...
Bye bye~!
scripts.translation:
[精煉大師]
其實，我偶爾也會為持有^006400精煉券^000000的冒險者提供精煉服務...
再見啦~！

scripts.text:
[Refine Master]
Greetings!
I can refine an item up to the ^006400same level as your ticket^000000.
You don't have to worry! There's no chance of breaking your item.
scripts.translation:
[精煉大師]
你好！我能把裝備精煉到^006400精煉券指定的等級^000000。
放心，裝備絕不會損毀。

scripts.text: You don't have to worry! There's no chance of breaking your item.
scripts.translation: 不用擔心，裝備絕不會損毀。

scripts.text: Refine item with ticket.

scripts.text: Okay.

scripts.text: You can come again later.

scripts.translation: [精煉大師]

You have to equip the item you want to refine.
scripts.translation:

請先穿戴要精煉的裝備。

scripts.text:
[Refine Master]
Oh, I'm sorry.
This item is impossible to refine.
scripts.translation:
[精煉大師]
哦，抱歉。
這件物品無法精煉。

scripts.text:
[Refine Master]
If you want to refine this ^006400Weapon^000000, please come along with ^006400Weapon Refine Ticket^000000.
See you later!
scripts.translation:

想精煉這件^006400武器^000000，請帶上^006400武器精煉券^000000。
回頭見！

scripts.text:
[Refine Master]
{0} is not in your inventory. Did you put it in your storage?
Please check again.
See you later!
scripts.translation:
[精煉大師]
你的物品欄裡沒有{0}。你把它放進倉庫了嗎？
請再次確認。
回頭見！

scripts.text:
[Refine Master]
^8B4513This item is already refined as much as your deed.^000000
Please come along with an item refined less than your ticket.
scripts.translation:
[精煉大師]
^8B4513這件裝備已經達到精煉券指定的精煉值。^000000
請換一件精煉值更低的裝備。

scripts.text:
[Refine Master]
I'm going to refine ^006400{0}^8B4513 up to the +{1} level^000000 with ^006400{2}^000000.
May I proceed?
No.
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text:
[Refine Master]
Oh, you changed your mind.
Ok.
You can come back later.
scripts.translation:
[精煉大師]
哦，改主意了？好，以後再來吧。

scripts.text:
[Refine Master]
Great.
As you wish!
I have my own special way to refine...
.......ka boom!
scripts.translation:

好，如你所願！

...轟隆！

scripts.text:

.......ka boom!
[Refine Master]
Wait a second...
Do you think I'm stupid?!
You switched the item while I wasn't looking! Get out of here!
scripts.translation:
[精煉大師]
好，如你所願！
我有獨門的精煉方法...
...轟隆！
[精煉大師]
等等...你以為我傻嗎？！
居然趁我不注意換了裝備！出去！
